metadata.explanation: Convergent amide disconnection to the heteroaryl carboxylic acid and aminomethyl pyridone. Atom inventory and reaction-class compatibility passed validation, but no exact dataset reaction or trusted template supported the cut; experimental feasibility is therefore uncertain.

Late-stage substitution of an activated chloropyridine by 1-methylpiperazine gives a first cut distinct from amidation. Atom inventory and class compatibility passed validation, but hidden evidence supplied no exact reaction or trusted-template support; treat this as a low-confidence proposal.

Direct aromatic formylation of chromane is a concise first cut. Validation passed structure and atom-inventory checks but found no dataset/template support, so this is a low-confidence proposal rather than experimental proof.

Chemoselective partial reduction of the corresponding aromatic carboxylic acid gives the aldehyde. Validation passed structure and atom-inventory checks but found no dataset/template support; the precursor was not confirmed in stock.
metadata.reaction_class: partial reduction of carboxylic acid to aldehyde

metadata.explanation: Reduce the corresponding nitro heteroarene to the primary amine. Disconnection validation found an exact dataset match with compatible atom inventory; this supports the transformation class but does not guarantee experimental success. Exact stock lookup for the nitro precursor returned no hit.

A distinct first cut proposes reductive N–O bond cleavage of the corresponding N-hydroxylamine. Structural and atom-inventory checks passed, but validation found no exact dataset reaction or trusted-template support, so this is a low-confidence exploratory disconnection. Exact stock lookup for this precursor returned no hit.
Exact dataset support was found for coupling N-Boc-L-proline with decylamine to form the protected amide. Both precursors were confirmed by exact stock lookup.
Exact dataset support was found for removal of an N-Boc group from the protected amide; this is the terminal deprotection after preserving the target stereocenter.

Alternative first cut disconnects the N-decyl bond to prolinamide and 1-bromodecane. Both precursors were confirmed by exact stock lookup, but validation found no exact dataset reaction or trusted template; this route is therefore speculative and may suffer competing alkylation at the pyrrolidine nitrogen.

Exact dataset support was found for reduction of the corresponding benzyl azide to the primary amine. Experimental feasibility still requires condition screening. The azide was checked by exact stock lookup and was not found, so this route is incomplete.

A nitrile-to-primary-amine reduction is chemically plausible and provides a distinct first cut, but validation found no exact dataset reaction or trusted-template support; therefore this is a low-confidence, incomplete proposal. No stock claim is made for the precursor.
